lines.0: Hi Aarav! Aaj cricket ki taaliyon se numbers pehchanenge. Taali, taali, taali, taali. Yeh kaun sa number hua?
lines.1: Haan, chaar taaliyan hui! Ab ek naya sawaal. Maan lo ghar ka number saat hai. Tum kitni taaliyan bajaoge?
lines.2: Haan, saat taaliyaan! Ab doosre tareeke se dikhate hain. Main bolti hoon eight. Tum ungliyon se kitni dikhaoge?
lines.3: Eight ko Hindi mein aath bolte hain. Ab apni ungliyon se eight dikhaoge?
lines.4: Tumne aath bola, haan! Main tumhari ungliyaan dekh nahi sakti. Ab bolo, seven kaun sa number hai? Hindi mein bhi bolo.
lines.5: Haan, seven ko Hindi mein saat bolte hain. Ab saat ko number ki nishaani mein kaise dikhate hain?
lines.6: Haan, seven aur saat ka numeral 7 hai! Ab do milte-julte numerals dekhenge. 6 aur 9 mein kya fark hai?
lines.7: Tumne gol ki jagah dekhi. Ab Bholu ne 6 ulta likha. Woh kehta hai, yeh ab bhi chhah hai. Kya woh sahi hai?
lines.8: Haan, 6 ulta ho toh 9 ban jaata hai. Ab chidiya waala sawaal. Taar par teen chidiyaan baithi hain; teeno udd gayi. Kitni bachi?
lines.9: Haan, teeno chidiyaan udd gayi, toh zero bachi. Ab cricket mein batsman bina run banaye out hua. Uska score kya hoga?
lines.10: Haan, batsman ka score zero hai, jaise chidiyaan zero bachi thi! Ab ulta gino: teen, do, ek. Iske baad kya aayega?
lines.11: Haan, ek ke baad ulta ginte hue zero aata hai! Ab number name suno. Nau kaun sa numeral hai?
lines.12: Bilkul sahi, tumne “nau” ko numeral 9 se match kiya. 6 aur 9 thode ek jaise dikhte hain. Inmein fark kya hai?
lines.13: Tum gol ki jagah bata rahe ho: 6 mein neeche, 9 mein oopar. Ab rotiyon ka sawaal. Do rotiyaan thi, dono kha li; kitni bachi?
lines.14: Haan, dono rotiyaan kha li, toh zero bachi. Tumne zero ki practice ki; numerals ke naam aur 6 aur 9 ko pehchaanne ki practice abhi aur chahiye. Aaj yahin rukhei

lines.0: Namaste Aarav, main Asha, tumhari AI teacher hoon. Aaj cricket-score jaise 1 se 9 aur zero likhenge. Tumhe cricket mein kya pasand hai?
lines.1: Batting mein chhakka maarna—wah! End mein Golu ko bhi sikhaayenge. Score 1 run ho to kitne runs likhoge?
lines.2: Bilkul, 1 run ke liye numeral 1 likhte hain. Screen par 3 balls hain—unke liye kaunsa numeral likhoge?
lines.3: Haan, 3 birds ke liye numeral 3. Ab sab birds fly away: kitne birds bache?
lines.4: Zero, haan—jab sab chale jaate hain, kuchh bhi nahi bachta. Ab aage kya karenge? Another flies away: ___ is left.
lines.5: Look at the step just before; what does it give us. Ab aage kya karenge? Another flies away: ___ is left.
lines.6: Tumne sahi dekha: zero mein se kuchh nahi ja sakta. Chalo, ek step pehle wale number par wapas dekhte hain. Ab aage kya karenge? Another flies away: ___ is left
lines.7: Haan, picture mein ek bird bacha hai. Us bird ko dikhane wala numeral socho. Ab aage kya karenge? Another flies away: ___ is left.
lines.8: Tumne bird ki jagah zero likha; picture mein ek bird hai, isliye one batao. Taali, taali, taali, taali. Yeh kaun sa number hua?
lines.9: Tumne taaliyon ko number se kaise match kiya?
lines.10: Bilkul, tumne chaar taali ginkar 4 bola—yeh sahi match tha. Main bolti hoon "eight". Ungliyon se 8 dikhao.
lines.11: Haan, eight ka matlab 8. Ungliyon se number dikhana matlab itni fingers upar karna. Main bolti hoon "eight". Ungliyon se 8 dikhao.
lines.12: Haan, 10 mein se 2 ungliyan neeche rakho, baaki ungliyan upar. Main bolti hoon "eight". Ungliyon se 8 dikhao.
lines.13: Tumne 8 ungliyan upar ki; ab number 7 ke liye taaliyan gin kar bajao. Tumhare ghar ka number 7 hai. Uske liye kitni taaliyaan bajaoge?
lines.14: Haan, 7 ke liye 7 taaliyan. 7 likhte waqt seedhi line upar hoti hai—ab 7 likhne ke liye pehle kya banaoge?

lines.0: Hi Ananya, I’m Asha, your AI teacher. Today we’ll estimate collections, like counting many cooking ingredients. What food do you enjoy making?
lines.1: Extra cheese on Maggi—nice! We’ll come back to that before we finish. A paper cone has peanuts; what might happen if it looks very full?
lines.2: Haan, full means many peanuts. We can first guess about 30, then count groups of 10. How many groups?
lines.3: Five boxes… keep going.
lines.4: Think of each box holding ten peanuts; count the boxes, then the peanuts. Try again.
lines.5: Ten, twenty… keep counting.
lines.6: Count one ten for each box: 10, 20, 30… now add the fourth and fifth. Try aloud.
lines.7: You counted five tens: 10, 20, 30, 40, 50. So the estimate is 50 peanuts.
lines.8: Haan Ananya, break lete hain. Wapas aao toh yahin se 5 boxes aur tens se shuru karenge.
lines.9: Welcome back, Ananya. Five boxes mean five tens. Can you count them by tens?
lines.10: Haan, har box mein 10 ho toh paanch boxes milkar 50 hote hain. 43 mein kitne tens aur kitne extra ones hain?
lines.11: 43 has 4 tens and 3 ones. What do we do next? 40 is ___ to 43, so it was a good estimate.
lines.12: Ek baar phir bolo, Ananya: What do we do next? 40 is ___ to 43, so it was a good estimate.
lines.13: Yes, “close” fits. 40 is close to 43, so 40 is a good estimate. Peanuts are in 3 paper cones. Each cone has 10 peanuts. How many peanuts in all?
lines.14: Tumne cones ki ginti batayi: 3. Har cone mein 10 peanuts hain. 3 tens milkar kitne peanuts?

lines.4: Tumne 45 socha. 65 se 5 ki chhalaang lagao, to 70 aata hai. Ab 70 se 100 tak 10 ki kitni chhalaangein lagenगी?
lines.5: Tumne 70 se 100 tak teen chhalaangein ginaayi. Isliye 65 se pehle 5, phir 30; kul 35 judte hain. 45 jodo to 110 ho jaata hai. Ab 48 mein kitna jodo ki 100 bane?

lines.8: Tumne 72 se 10 ki chhalaang sochkar 82 kaha. Ab ek nayi sankhya rekha par 55 se 100 tak pahunchna hai. Kaun-kaun si chhalaangein lagaoge?
lines.9: Tumne 55 se 60, phir 100 tak ki chhalaangein bataayin. Chaar 10 ki chhalaangein aur pehli 5 ki chhalaang milakar kul kitna juda?
lines.10: Haan, 5 aur 40 milkar 45 hote hain. Ab cricket ki baari! Batter ke 87 run hain. Sau run poore karne ke liye aur kitne run chahiye?
lines.11: Bilkul, 87 mein 13 jodne se sau run poore hote hain. Ab dukaan ka sawaal: 38 rupaye ki toffee li aur 100 rupaye diye. Kitne rupaye wapas milenge?
lines.12: Bilkul, 38 rupaye dene par 62 rupaye wapas milenge. Ab tumhare paas 80 rupaye hain. 100 rupaye banane ke liye aur kitne chahiye?
lines.13: Sahi, 80 mein 20 jodne se 100 banta hai. Ab rupayon se hatkar dahaiyon ko socho. 40 ke saath kitna jodoge ki 100 bane?
lines.14: Tumne kitna kaha? Ek baar phir bolo: 40 ke saath kya milaayein ki 100 bane?

lines.2: Tum counted on from ten to twelve. Now try a new one. A bundle has ten sticks, with three loose sticks. How many sticks are there altogether?
lines.3: You counted the bundle as one stick; the bundle holds ten sticks. One bundle of 10 and 3 loose sticks. Guess how many sticks altogether before we count.
lines.4: Yes, tum got thirteen! The bundle counts as ten sticks, not one. Now Papa has a box of ten laddoos and six loose laddoos. How many laddoos are there altogether?
lines.5: Tum counted from ten and said sixteen for the laddoos. Let’s try eggs now. A full tray holds ten eggs, and four more are in a bowl. How many eggs are there alto
lines.6: Tum said fourteen, then felt unsure. The full tray has ten eggs. Count four more from ten: eleven, twelve, thirteen, then what comes next, tum?
lines.7: Tum got stuck after thirteen, then said fourteen. Let’s count slowly: ten, eleven, twelve, thirteen, fourteen. So how many eggs are there altogether, tum?
lines.8: Tum said fourteen eggs. I ask counting questions to help us see how ten grows. Yes, I am an AI teacher, not a person. A full ten-frame has ten counters; for eig
lines.9: Tum think eight extra counters, but you wonder if the one means just one. Let’s try nineteen. Bholu says its one means one stick, so he counts ten sticks altoge
lines.10: Tum noticed Bholu counted the bundle as just one stick. A bundle holds ten sticks. Now think of seventeen: one bundle of ten, and how many loose sticks, tum?
lines.11: Tum said seven loose sticks, and you wondered about the one. In seventeen, the one means one whole bundle of ten. Now, one bundle of ten and one loose stick mak

lines.13: Tum chose Riya, and tum are wondering about the one. In fourteen, that one means one whole ten, not one loose thing. Now for sixteen, which digit comes first, t
lines.14: Now let’s compare two numbers. Which is more, thirteen or eighteen, tum?

lines.0: Namaste Gauri, main Asha, tumhari AI teacher. Aaj hum 10 banane ke alag tareeqe dekhenge. Tumhe animals ya dancing zyada pasand hai?
lines.1: White doggy park mein—wah! End mein dogs par wapas aayenge. 10 biscuits mein 4 doggies ko do—kitne bachenge, tum kya sochti ho?
lines.2: Bilkul, 10 biscuits mein 4 diye, toh 6 bache: 4 aur 6 milkar 10. Ab 7 ke saath kitne?
lines.3: Haan, 7 aur 3 milkar 10. Ab fingers se 7 dikhao—10 fingers tak pahunchne ke liye kitni aur chahiye?
lines.4: Haan, 7 ke saath 10 banane ke liye sirf 3 chahiye. Show 10 fingers, keep 7 up, fold the rest. Ab aage kya karenge? Count the folded fingers: ___.
lines.5: Haan, tum 7 ungliyan khadi rakho aur bachi hui ungliyan dheere se fold karo. Ab aage kya karenge? Count the folded fingers: ___.
lines.6: Haan Gauri, tumne 3 hi bola tha. Tumhari baat ko main dobara saaf tareeke se likh rahi hoon. Ab aage kya karenge? Count the folded fingers: ___.
lines.7: Dogs aur animals ki baat yaad hai, Gauri. 8 mein kitne aur milaayein to 10 banega?
lines.8: Haan, 8 ke saath 2 jodkar tumne 10 banaya. Ab 6 ke saath kitna jodoge?
lines.9: Theek hai, Gauri—tum break lena chahti ho. Carry on, chhota break, ya aaj stop: tum choose karo.
lines.10: Theek hai Gauri, chhota break lo; lesson yahin rukta hai. Wapas aakar hum isi jagah se shuru karenge.
lines.11: Theek hai Gauri, tum cricket dekho aur aaram karo. Maths lesson abhi stop karte hain.
lines.12: Wah, favourite batsman ki batting aa gayi! Hum lesson ke end se pehle cricket par phir baat karenge. 10 banane ke do alag tareeke batao.
lines.13: Tumne 5 aur 5 likha; ab divider ek bead sarakao aur dono parts gino. 10 banane ke do alag tareeke batao.
lines.14: 5 aur 5 tumne dikhaya. Ab 10 counters ko do groups mein baanto, pehle group mein 4 rakho. 10 banane ke do alag tareeke batao.

lines.0: Hi Om! Aaj hum patang ki dori se khadi, leti aur tirchi lines pehchanenge. Jhande ka danda kaisi line hai: khadi, leti ya tirchi?
lines.1: Haan, jhande ka danda khadi line hai, upar neeche jaata hai. Ab ek khambe aur deewar se lagi seedhi ko socho. Dono seedhe hain, phir bhi unmein kya farak hai?
lines.2: B side ko jhuki hai. A khadi hai, aur B tirchi hai; jhukne par bhi woh seedhi line hai. Ab pencil khadi pakdi hai. Agar woh table par let jaaye, toh kaisi line
lines.3: Haan, pencil table par lete toh leti line banegi. Ab V akshar socho. Koi kahe V mein curved lines hain kyunki woh tirchi hain. Kya woh sahi hai?
lines.4: Haan, V ki dono tirchi lines seedhi hain. Corner hone se line curved nahi hoti; curved line gol mudti hai. Chudi ka kinaara seedha hai ya curved?
lines.5: Haan, chudi ka kinaara curved hai, kyunki woh gol mudta hai. Ab park ki slide socho. Uski seedhi phisalne wali dhaar khadi, leti ya tirchi hoti hai?
lines.6: Haan, slide ki dhaar tirchi hai, aur seedhi bhi hai. Jhukne se line curved nahi hoti. Ab bade T mein kaunsi line khadi hai aur kaunsi leti?
lines.7: Tumne T ki dono lines batayi. Ab HAT ke akshar socho. Usmein ek khadi, ek leti aur ek tirchi line kahan milegi?
lines.8: Tumne HAT mein khadi, leti aur tirchi lines dhoondi. Ab hawa mein ek khadi line banao, phir uske neeche se right taraf leti line banao. Kaunsa bada akshar bana?
lines.9: Haan, bada L bana! Usmein ek khadi aur ek leti line hai. Ab V mein kona hota hai, par uski dono tirchi lines seedhi hain. Chudi ka kinaara bina kone ke gol mudt
lines.10: Haan, sahi! V ki dono tirchi lines seedhi hain; chudi ka kinaara curved hai. Ab tumhare liye game taiyaar kar rahi hoon.
lines.11: Football wala game chahiye! Main game taiyaar kar rahi hoon; football wala milna pakka nahi. Tab tak socho, football ki gol kinaari curved hoti hai.
lines.12: Haan, football ka gol kinaara curved hai. Main phir se game taiyaar kar rahi hoon. Tab tak football goalpost ki side wali line khadi hoti hai ya leti?
lines.13: Bilkul, goalpost ki side khadi line hai. Football-line game: tum ek khadi, leti, aur tirchi line bolo. Pehle kaunsi?
lines.14: Haan, goalpost ki side khadi hai. Main phir koshish karti hoon; tab tak football wala bolkar khelte hain. Goalpost ki upar wali seedhi line khadi hai ya leti?

lines.0: Namaste Om, main Asha, tumhari AI teacher. Aaj standing, sleeping aur slanting lines dekhenge. Tumhe football ya kites mein kya pasand hai?
lines.1: Ronaldo ka goal “boing” rocket jaisa laga! End mein ispar lautenge; ab crease line standing hai ya sleeping?
lines.2: Bilkul, goal post ki tarah khadi line standing line hoti hai. Football field ki seedhi side-line standing hai ya sleeping?
lines.3: Haan, “leti hui” line sleeping hoti hai. Ab letter A ki left side dekho—woh kis taraf jhukti hai?
lines.4: Letter A ki left side tirchi dikh rahi hai. Ab aage kya karenge? So A has two slanting lines and one sleeping line, all ___.
lines.5: Haan, teeno straight lines hain—tumne A ki sides aur beech wali line pehchaani. Park ki slide kaisi line banati hai: khadi, leti ya tirchi?
lines.6: Haan, slide ki direction tumne sahi pehchaani—tumhe kaise pata chala ki woh slanting hai?
lines.7: Tumne slide ki direction dekhi. Ab pencil se ek tirchi line banao, jo bina mode upar se neeche jaaye.
lines.8: Line A khambe jaisi khadi hai. Line B deewar se lagi seedhi (ladder) jaisi jhuki hai. Dono seedhi hain. Farak kya hai?
lines.9: Tumne A ko khadi aur B ko tirchi kaha. Ab dono ka farak ek baar phir bolo. Line A khambe jaisi khadi hai. Line B deewar se lagi seedhi (ladder) jaisi jhuki hai.
lines.10: Yeh line neeche left se upar right tak jaati hai, park ki slide jaisi. Kya yeh seedhi line hai?
lines.11: Haan, tumne slanting aur straight dono sahi pehchaane. Jhande ka dandaa khadi line hai, leti line hai, ya tirchi line?
lines.12: Bilkul, jhande ka dandaa standing straight line hai. Ab football goalpost ka crossbar dekho: kaunsi line?
lines.13: Tumne “leti hui” kehkar line ka direction bataya. Ab agla example dekho. Chudi ka kinaara seedhi line hai ya curved line?
lines.14: Haan, O ki boundary curved line hoti hai, kyunki woh gol ghoomti hai. Letter L mein kaunsi straight line dikhti hai?

lines.0: Namaste Neel, main Asha, aapki AI teacher hoon. Aaj base aur place value dekhenge. Aapko kites ya football mein kya pasand hai?
lines.1: Patang ज़्यादा मज़ेदार—ठीक है, अंत में इसी से जोड़ेंगे। सोचिए, पतंग की डोर पर 5, 50, 500 गांठें हों; कौन-सी गिनती अलग लगेगी?
lines.2: हर अंक की जगह सोचकर आगे कहिए।
lines.3: Screen par 45 aur 2 dekhiye: 45 mein 4 tens ki, 5 ones ki; 2 ki kaunsi place hai, bataiye?
lines.4: Neel, screen par 45 aur 2 hain: 2 akela hai, isliye ones; 45 mein 4 tens aur 5 ones. Ab 45 ko place-values se phailaaiye.
lines.5: Haan, bilkul: 4 tens ka 40 aur 5 ones ka 5, yani 40 plus 5. Ab 2 ke powers mein 45 se chhota sabse bada power bataiye.
lines.6: Base 2 मतलब हर जगह 2 गुना बढ़ती है: 1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 32. Aap 1 se 2 guna karke agla number boliye.
lines.7: Aap 1 se har baar 2 guna kar rahe hain—isi ko base 2 ki powers kehte hain. Agle do numbers boliye.
lines.8: Neel, ye code nahi; base 2 mein har place ki value 2-guni hoti hai. Aap 1, 2, 4, 8 ko place-values ki seedhi samajhiye.
lines.9: Screen par 1, 2, 4, 8 wali seedhi dekhiye: har agla place pichhle ka 2 guna hai. 8 ke baad kya aayega?
lines.10: Screen ki seedhi dekhiye: 1 → 2 → 4 → 8 → 16. Har paaydaan par pichhli value double hoti hai. 16 ke baad?
lines.11: Screen par 32 ko base 10 ka number maan rahe hain; base 2 mein 32 ko 100000 likhte hain. 32 kis base ka tha?
lines.12: Base 10 mein digits 0 se 9 tak hote hain; base 2 mein sirf 0 aur 1. Khaali jagah bhariye: 45 = ___ in base 2.
lines.13: Base 2 mein har place ki value 2 ki power hoti hai: 1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 32. Isliye yeh base 10 se alag likhne ka tareeka hai. Khaali jagah bhariye: 45 = ___ in base
lines.14: Kites aur football mein direction jaise, yahan place-values direction deti hain. Aapne 101101 likha; ab bataiye, ismein 32 wali place ka digit kaunsa hai?

lines.2: Yes, thirty-seven! Tum added the tens and ones. Now try two sums: twenty-four plus thirteen, and twenty-four plus eighteen. Why does only one make a new ten?
lines.3: Twenty-four plus thirteen is thirty-seven. For twenty-four plus eighteen, four ones and eight ones make twelve ones. That makes a new ten. Tum, for twenty-six p
lines.4: Yes, tum! Six ones and seven ones make thirteen ones, so we make a new ten. Now imagine ten-rupee notes and one-rupee coins. For nineteen rupees plus twenty-thr
lines.5: Yes, forty-two rupees! Tum made a new ten from the coins. Now someone says thirty-six plus twenty-five is five hundred eleven. What went wrong?
lines.6: Haan, that answer is wrong. No problem, tum. Let’s start with the ones: six ones plus five ones make how many ones?
lines.7: Eleven ones, yes. Tum can make one new ten from ten of them. How many ones are left?
lines.8: One one is left, tum. The other ten ones become one new ten. Does that new ten join the tens or stay in the ones place?

lines.10: Tum said four, then checked again. Three tens and two tens make five tens. One new ten joins them. How many tens now?
lines.11: Haan, chhe tens. Five tens plus one new ten make six tens. Tum, in the answer five hundred eleven, what happened to the new ten?
lines.12: Tum noticed the new ten was forgotten. Eleven ones cannot all stay in the ones place. Ten ones make a new ten. How many ones are left?
lines.13: Yes, tum, one one is left. The new ten joins the other tens. What number should replace five hundred eleven?

lines.4: Aap keh rahe hain ki decimal kabhi khatam na ho toh fraction nahi ho sakta. Par aapka apna example ek bata teen fraction hai, aur uska decimal 0.333… hai: repea

lines.8: Aapne 15/90 ko 1/6 sahi simplify kiya. 3/8 ko decimal mein likhiye. Kya yeh khatam hota hai?
lines.9: Bilkul, three eighths ka decimal 0.375 hai aur teen digits ke baad rukta hai. Ab thoda harder: 0.272727… mein kaunse digits repeat ho rahe hain? Use bar notatio

lines.11: Aapne 20 ko 2 aur 5 ke factors mein toda, phir decimal se check kiya. Ab contrast mein 1/7 sochiye: kya iska decimal rukega, aur agar nahi, toh repeating block
lines.12: Aapne denominator mein 7 dekha, aur 142857 ka six-digit repeat bhi yaad kiya. Ab usi pattern ko use karke, bina divide kiye 2/7 ka decimal kya hoga?

lines.11: Tumne teenon representations sahi banaye: 2⁶, 4³, 8². Har baar repeated multiplication ka count exponent hota hai. What is 3⁴ as multiplication?

lines.0: Namaste Dev, main Asha, aapki AI teacher. Aaj circles ki definitions aur symmetry drawing se dekhenge. Aap drawing mein circle kaise banate hain?
lines.1: Bilkul—compass ka fixed point centre hota hai, aur pencil ki doori radius. Ghoomate waqt boundary ke points centre se kitni door honge?
lines.2: Sahi: circle ki boundary ka har point centre se radius jitni door hota hai. Ab centre se guzarti seedhi line ko kya kahenge?
lines.3: Haan, diameter centre se guzarta hai aur circle ke do points ko jodta hai; yeh do radii ke barabar hota hai. AB ke baare mein batayiye.
lines.4: Haan, AB chord hai: yeh circle ke do points ko seedhi line se jodta hai. Curve A se B tak ko kya kahenge?
lines.5: Bilkul, A se B tak circle ki boundary ka koi bhi hissa arc hota hai—chhota arc ya bada arc. OAB wala region kya kehlayega?
lines.6: Ab seedhe cut aur gol boundary se bane doosre tukde ko dhyaan se dekhiye. Pizza ka slice aur ek seedhe chaaku ke cut se kata tukda: kaunsa sector hai aur kaunsa
lines.7: Segment mein ek seedhi line aur circle ki boundary ka ek hissa hota hai. Sector mein do radii aur boundary ka hissa hota hai. Pizza ka slice aur ek seedhe chaak
lines.8: Bilkul sahi: aapne sector mein centre se jaane wali do radii aur segment mein chord pehchaani. Jo chord diameter nahi hai woh circle ko do hisson mein baantti h
lines.9: Aap arc aur segment ko mix kar rahe hain. Segment, chord aur arc se bana circle ka region hota hai; ab in dono regions ke size par dhyaan dijiye. Jo chord diame
lines.10: Haan, minor segment aur major segment—achchha check kiya. Aapne kaise pehchaana ki ye arc nahi, circle ke regions hain?
lines.11: Bilkul, aapne method sahi pakda: arc boundary ka curved hissa, segment chord aur arc se ghira region. Kaunsa statement sahi hai?
lines.12: Sahi: aapne kaha ki centre se guzarne wali chord diameter hoti hai. Is region ka naam bataiye: chord aur uske chhote arc ke beech ka hissa.
lines.13: Pehla hissa sahi: chord aur chhote arc ke beech ka region minor segment hai; kya hamesha chhota arc hi chhota region banata hai?
lines.14: Aapne exception pakda: segment ka size chord ki position aur arc dono par nirbhar hai. Ab major segment ko apne shabdon mein samjhaiye.

lines.0: Namaste Anika, main Asha, tumhari AI teacher. Aaj hum dekhenge cheezein roll, slide ya stack karti hain. Tumhe dancing ya animals mein kya pasand hai?
lines.1: Anika, Priya ke saath naya dance step seekha—end mein tum mujhe yaad dilana. Ab ball ko dhakka dogi, kya hoga?
lines.2: Bilkul, Anika! Ball ki curved surface use roll karati hai. Screen par “Curved surfaces” ke neeche kya likha hai?
lines.3: Chalo spoken game: tum ghar ki ek cheez bolo, main bataungi—roll, slide, ya stack. Pehli cheez kya hai?
lines.4: Kya woh roll karegi ya slide?
lines.5: Anika, bottle ki flat side table par slide karti hai. Kya bottle ko seedha khada karke doosri bottle stack hogi?
lines.6: Bilkul, Anika—flat top wali bottle stack hoti hai; gol top wali phisal sakti hai. Tum ek example bataogi?
lines.7: Flat side upar rakho, phir batao.
lines.8: Anika, tum rukna chahti ho—tum carry on, short break, ya aaj stop choose kar sakti ho; screen par bhi choices hain.
lines.9: Theek hai, Anika. Aaj tumne flat sides se slide aur stack ka reason bataya. Bye, Anika—apna dhyaan rakhna.
